paragraphs: The F-Pace 300 Sport is a special-edition variant launched in 2022, positioned as a diesel-focused sporty addition to the F-Pace range alongside the 400 Sport petrol. It uses the Ingenium AJ300D — a 3.0-litre straight-six diesel with mild-hybrid technology, producing 300PS. This is the same engine family used in the F-Pace D300, but in a distinct trim-specific application with its own badging and equipment level. The 300 Sport ran alongside the rest of the F-Pace range from 2022 onwards, offering diesel buyers a more sporting alternative to the standard D300.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D engines for every F-Pace 300 Sport on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre straight-six diesel MHEV fitted to the F-Pace 300 Sport from 2022 to present (X761 generation). This is the same Ingenium diesel six-cylinder used across the wider JLR range, with timing chain wear and injector seal failure as documented wear patterns — see the callout above.
